import hashlib
import json
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out=root/'target/structure-review'
results=[]
for round_index in range(6):
    order=['baseline','candidate'] if round_index%2==0 else ['candidate','baseline']
    for side in order:
        name=f'structure-{side}-{round_index}'
        binary=out/f'{side}-bench'
        argv=[str(binary),'--bench','structural_constraint','--noplot']
        if round_index==0: argv+=['--profile-time','1']
        else: argv+=['--save-baseline',name]
        print(name,flush=True)
        started=time.perf_counter()
        with (out/f'{name}.log').open('w') as log:
            subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time','-l','-o',str(out/f'{name}.time'),*argv],cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=log,check=True)
        elapsed=time.perf_counter()-started
        usage=(out/f'{name}.time').read_text()
        rss=int(re.search(r'(\d+)\s+maximum resident set size',usage)[1])
        row={'side':side,'round':round_index,'warmup':round_index==0,'argv':argv,'wall_s':elapsed,'rss_bytes':rss,'workloads':{}}
        if round_index:
            for path in (root/'target/criterion/structural_constraint').glob(f'*/{name}/estimates.json'):
                sample=json.loads((path.parent/'sample.json').read_text())
                ns=sorted(t/n for t,n in zip(sample['times'],sample['iters']))
                row['workloads'][path.parent.parent.name]={'estimates':json.loads(path.read_text()),'sample_ns':ns,'sample_p95_ns':ns[(95*len(ns)+99)//100-1]}
            assert len(row['workloads'])==9, row['workloads'].keys()
        results.append(row)
        (out/'criterion-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(name,'completed',round(elapsed,2),'seconds',flush=True)
